[[Zehtuka's Pack]] is one of four items belonging to [[the Great Zehtuka]] that randomly appears in the [[explorable area]]s of [[the Desolation]]. The other three items are [[Zehtuka's Great Horn]], [[Zehtuka's Jug]], and [[Zehtuka's Shortbow]].

It is a container with 10 inventory slots when equipped and is functionally identical to a normal [[Bag]] that has been upgraded with a [[Rune of Holding]]. A [[Superior Rune of Holding]] can be applied to Zehtuka's Pack and make it hold 15 items instead of 10 items. 



==Acquisition==
As with all of Zehtuka's items, Zehtuka's Pack has a chance of dropping only when the party approaches one of its spawning locations:

* [[The Desolation]]
** [[Poisoned Outcrops]] (across the bridge west of [[Lahati]], see [[:Image:Zehtukas pack poisoned outcrops map.jpg|map]])
** [[The Alkali Pan]] (slightly north of [[Vah the Crafty]], at the northern tip of the non-sulphurous patch, see [[:File:Zehtuka's Pack The Alkali Pan map.jpg|map]])
** [[The Ruptured Heart]] (near the [[Buried Treasure]] that is in this area)
** [[The Sulfurous Wastes]] (near [[Infantryman Hareh]], across the column that you have to knock down)
** [[Joko's Domain]] (near [[Keht the Fierce]], by the rock wall)
** [[The Shattered Ravines]] (in the clearing on top of the hillock in the southeast, near [[Chinwe]])

== Notes ==
* Unlike some containers, Zehtuka's Pack cannot be [[dye]]d.
* It uses the same icon as a [[Charr Bag]], [[Jun's Art Supplies]], and [[Tasca's Pack]].
* Empty packs can be moved into inventory or [[storage]], but, as with any [[container]], they cannot be unequipped until you remove all their inventory [[item]]s.
